metadata.processing: Reprojected to WGS84 and clipped to the Underflow study rectangle. Flood boundary simplified at 0.000018 degrees (~2 m). Source area fields removed because geometry was clipped.
metadata.scope: Source shapefile covers Nairobi and Kiambu; displayed extract intersects the study rectangle. Coverage and cloud layers accompany the observed extent.
metadata.attribution: Analysis and production: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT); source imagery CNES 2024 / Airbus Defence and Space. No satellite imagery redistributed.

visual_reveal.method: Multipolygon split into unchanged component polygons. Area-weighted centroid distance to the nearest mapped waterway line segment, in a local metric approximation centred at 36.86E, 1.29S.
visual_reveal.purpose: Visual ordering of the fixed satellite observation only. Not within-event flood growth, flood timing, travel time, hydraulic modelling, or a pixel-level distance field.
visual_reveal.reference: Current OSM waterways snapshot, 2 November 2026; this does not reconstruct 2024 channels.

visual_tour.source: Fixed UNOSAT observation, 1 May 2024; current OSM Nairobi River for context
visual_tour.method: Select components above 100 square metres whose centroid is within 350 m of the mapped Nairobi River. Sort west to east, divide into six equal-count longitude groups, and visit the largest outer-ring component in each group.
visual_tour.interpretation: Selected observed locations only, not all affected sections. Tour ordering and camera motion are editorial, not flood timing. Reused in the 2026 illustration as historical context, not predicted locations.
